text: The owned 1276 code replaces membership string comparisons with MatrixSDK.KnownMembership values in room lifecycle and localized event rendering. The MATRIX_EVENT_HANDLERS handlers remain named ban, invite, join and leave because those keys select protocol event cases. A scoped source pattern is to use the SDK enum for comparisons without mechanically changing wire/event-map keys or Fluent IDs. This is specific to this integration, not an all-enums project rule. This is source and test inspection only. Full Bugzilla and historical review timeline/inline context remain pending. No Thunderbird runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check ran.
title: Use the Matrix membership enum at the SDK boundary while preserving event keys
